title: deno
description: A json schema definition for Deno management

remove.description: Indicates all versions and files created by this role should be removed. Default 'false'.

location.description: Defines values for installation location configuration.

owner.description: The owner of the installation location. Defaults to 'hth_deno_default_install_path_owner'.

group.description: The group owning the installation location. Defaults to 'hth_deno_default_install_path_group'.

mode.description: The access mode of the installation location. Defaults to 'hth_deno_default_install_path_mode'

path.description: The path to where new versions will be placed. Defaults to 'hth_deno_default_install_path'

primary.description: Indicates the version that should be set as the primary version linked to the path.

checksum.description: The checksum for the version as supplied along side the artifact on their release page.

remove.description: Indicates if this version should be removed. Default 'false'
